en.tagline: Plan and analyse social media, with a free plan
en.description: Metricool, a Spanish company, combines scheduling for all major networks with detailed analytics, competitor analysis and ad reporting. Pricing is based on the number of brands rather than channels.
bestFor: Entrepreneurs and agencies that need reporting
notFor: Enterprise teams with complex approval flows
